articles.title: Sonu Nigam Buys Rs 44.30 Crore Apartment in Mumbai's Andheri West
articles.excerpt: The 3,055 sq ft apartment in Vartamaan on Juhu Versova Link Road includes four parking spaces; the deal was registered on October 30 with Rs 2.65 crore in stamp duty, registration documents show.
articles.image_caption: Mumbai's Andheri West
articles.nri_angle: A registered, document-based record of a major Bollywood singer's Mumbai home purchase, kept strictly to the filing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.card_title: Recent Property Transactions by Sonu Nigam

articles.title: Rajamouli's Varanasi Reportedly Sets Record Telugu Theatrical Deal
articles.excerpt: Trade reports put the Telugu-states deal for the Mahesh Babu film at Rs. 290-300 crore, above RRR's reported Rs. 225 crore, with official confirmation still awaited ahead of the April 7, 2027 release.
articles.image_caption: Varanasi
articles.nri_angle: Telugu diaspora audiences get a dated worldwide theatrical release — April 7, 2027 — for Rajamouli and Mahesh Babu's first film together.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Ramayana' Becomes First Indian Film to Debut at No. 1 in UK and Ireland
articles.excerpt: Nitesh Tiwari's Hindi-language epic, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi, tops the UK and Ireland chart on its opening weekend and sets a new record for an Indian film in the territory.
articles.nri_angle: A Hindi-language Indian epic topping the UK and Ireland chart is a first for the large Indian diaspora audience in Britain and Ireland, where the film is now in wide release in Hindi and English.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Jumps 150% on Sixth Monday, Nears Profitability Milestone
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's Hindi thriller reached ₹380.07 crore net in India after 39 days, leaving it ₹1.52 crore short of the mark Koimoi sets for it to become 2026's third most profitable Hindi film.
articles.image_caption: Drishyam Indian thriller drama film directed by Nishikant Kamat. Drishyam 3: The Conclusion, the Hindi crime thriller starring Ajay Devgn, jumped about 150% on its sixth Monday (day 39) to roughly ₹20 lakh, up from about ₹8 lakh the previous day, according to Koimoi.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Sureshsharmaptv63 via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

sources.label: The Times of India via NewsPoint

articles.nri_angle: Overseas markets contributed ₹144.89 crore of the film's ₹593.42 crore worldwide gross, just under a quarter of its total.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ranveer Singh's Grandfather Ram Hingorani, His 'Rockstar Nana,' Dies at 96
articles.excerpt: Dr Ram Hingorani died during Lakshmi Puja on Diwali, November 8, his granddaughter Saumya confirmed on Instagram, as the family remembered a man Ranveer once celebrated for voting at 93 in Mumbai's heat.
articles.image_caption: Actor Ranveer Singh, whose maternal grandfather Dr Ram Hingorani, known as his 'Rockstar Nana', has died at 96.
articles.nri_angle: The family's Diwali farewell, shared on Instagram, reached fans and relatives across the diaspora who knew Dr Hingorani as Ranveer's 'Rockstar Nana'.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Swara Bhasker Hosts Qawwali Baithak at Home to Celebrate Diwali After Rise and Fall
articles.excerpt: The actor welcomed Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Faye D'Souza and designer Aprajita Toor for an evening of live Qawwali by Arif Naza and party, telling Filmibeat she wanted a celebration that felt intimate, warm and full of life.
articles.image_caption: Qawwali
articles.nri_angle: Swara Bhasker's home Qawwali baithak is the intimate, music-first end of Diwali celebration — the kind of gathering diaspora families recreate abroad, built around live performance, food and close company rather than scale.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gurfateh Pirzada Says Diwali Crackers Burnt His Mumbai Balcony and Room
articles.excerpt: The Lust Stories 3 actor shared photos of a smoke-filled balcony and a damaged room on Instagram Stories, tagged the BMC and Mumbai Police, and shared an AQI screenshot reading 521.
articles.nri_angle: A Bollywood actor's burnt balcony puts a face on the Diwali firecracker fires and severe post-festival air pollution that families across Indian metros — and relatives visiting for the festival — faced this season.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Diwali Noir Brings New York Fashion to BOOM for Festival of Lights
articles.excerpt: ŌUSHQ and the CFDA filled BOOM at The Standard with brocades, jewel-toned silks and Indian designers on November 5 — and used the night to relaunch ŌUSHQ's platform.
articles.image_caption: Guests in Indian-inspired festive dress at the Diwali Noir party at BOOM at The Standard, High Line. ŌUSHQ and the CFDA hosted the November 5, 2026 celebration of Diwali and Indian craftsmanship.
articles.nri_angle: Diwali Noir puts South Asian designers and craftsmanship at the center of New York fashion's own calendar, hosted by two Indian-origin founders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items: Diwali Noir hosted by ŌUSHQ and CFDA at The Standard, High Line.
Second edition of the event, following last year's inaugural party.
Guests wore contemporary Indian-inspired fashion, including brocades and jewel-toned silks.
ŌUSHQ's e-commerce site relaunched alongside the debut of ŌUSHQ ŌUTLINE.

articles.title: Tyra Banks Wears Emerald Lehenga for Maneesh Goyal's New York Diwali Party
articles.excerpt: In her first complete traditional Indian look, Banks wore a custom Maison Tai lehenga and a Kalyan Jewellers diamond set from its New Jersey showroom — and praised the paneer.
articles.image_caption: Tyra Banks wears an emerald-green and gold lehenga with traditional diamond jewellery, including a maang tikka. She wore the look for Maneesh Goyal's Diwali celebration in New York.
articles.nri_angle: Diwali's place in New York's mainstream social calendar, told through one high-profile guest's first full traditional look and the Indian jeweller behind it.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Samay Raina Shares Diwali Photo With Medha Shankr, Rumours Return
articles.excerpt: The comedian posted a Diwali picture with the 12th Fail actress from his Mumbai bash, weeks after telling Varun Dhawan on Koffee With Karan that he was chilling with his girlfriend.
articles.image_caption: Samay Raina and Medha Shankr are pictured in a split photograph. Raina shared a Diwali photo with Shankr days after a viral comment renewed dating rumours.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora fans following Indian comedy and film stars on social media, the Diwali photo shows how a single post can revive unconfirmed rumours.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Farah Khan Says Superstar Era Is Over, Calls New Actors Insecure
articles.excerpt: On Double Date, the filmmaker said younger actors interfere in choreography, music and casting, and named Shah Rukh Khan, Amitabh Bachchan, Salman Khan and Akshay Kumar as the last superstars.
articles.image_caption: Farah Khan is pictured in a portrait photograph. The filmmaker said on Double Date that the era of superstars is over and described today's actors as insecure.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences raised on star-driven Hindi cinema, Farah Khan's verdict raises whether any new actor can command the same single-name draw.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Demonte Colony 3 Locks Pongal 2027 Release After Court-Linked Delay
articles.excerpt: Arulnithi and Priya Bhavani Shankar return in the third Tamil instalment of R. Ajay Gnanamuthu's horror franchise, moved from September 2026 after a Madras High Court injunction in a production rights dispute.
articles.image_caption: Promotional art for Demonte Colony 3 shows its lead character standing in a flooded graveyard under a full moon. The Tamil horror film is set to release during Pongal 2027.
articles.nri_angle: Tamil horror has a strong US theatrical audience during Pongal; no US release date has been announced for the film yet.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Filmmakers Hail 'Ramayana' as India's 'Lord of the Rings' as Epic Opens Worldwide
articles.excerpt: Nitesh Tiwari's two-part epic, made over more than a decade with a reported $420 million combined budget, draws praise from Rajamouli, Vanga and Rishab Shetty — and an opening-day India take of Rs 64.85 crore.
articles.image_caption: Ranbir Kapoor stands in front of the Ramayana title backdrop at a film event. Kapoor plays Rama in Nitesh Tiwari's two-part epic, which opened in cinemas worldwide on November 5.
articles.nri_angle: The English version and Sony's international distribution put the film in US theatres now, pitched directly at global and diaspora audiences.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items: SS Rajamouli praised the film's scale and visuals.
Sandeep Reddy Vanga urged audiences to experience it on the big screen.
Rishab Shetty commended the makers for justice to the epic.

articles.title: Dhanush Says No Diwali or Pongal Feels Complete Without Solomon Pappaiah
articles.excerpt: The Tamil actor marked Diwali with a post on X remembering the late Pattimandram moderator, writing that he cannot remember a Diwali or Pongal without him since childhood.
articles.image_caption: Dhanush, the Tamil actor, in a file photograph.
articles.nri_angle: Pappaiah's Pattimandram debates were festival-day viewing for Tamil families in India and across the diaspora, so Dhanush's tribute names a shared childhood experience for Tamil readers abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ramayana Trade Trackers Predict Rs 450 Crore Worldwide by Diwali Day Four
articles.excerpt: Filmibeat predicts the Ranbir Kapoor film might touch Rs 450 crore worldwide on its Diwali Sunday, while Pinkvilla tracks the four-day weekend nearer Rs 490 crore — both figures are trade estimates, not results.
articles.image_caption: Ramayana
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana is drawing record single-day overseas business in the US and UK, making its Diwali weekend a major theatrical event for diaspora audiences.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal Reveal Son Vihaan's Face in Diwali Post
articles.excerpt: A day after Vihaan turned one, Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal shared the first clear photograph of their son's face in a joint Diwali Instagram post — ending a year of carefully guarded glimpses.
articles.image_caption: Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal pose with their son Vihaan, who waves at the camera in a yellow embroidered jacket. The couple shared the first clear photograph of Vihaan's face in a Diwali post on November 8, a day after his first birthday.
articles.nri_angle: One of Bollywood's most-watched couples chose Diwali — and their son's first-birthday weekend — for the reveal diaspora fans had been waiting for.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Daler Mehndi Thanks Mika Singh in Diwali Message After Uttarakhand Stage Row
articles.excerpt: Three weeks after a Uttarakhand minister interrupted his live show and alleged he was intoxicated and lip-syncing — allegations his family denies — Daler Mehndi used a Diwali Instagram note to thank his brother, his family and the industry for standing by him.
articles.image_caption: Daler Mehndi performs on stage, microphone in hand, during a live show. The singer posted a Diwali message on November 8 thanking his brother Mika Singh and his family for standing by him after the Uttarakhand concert row.
articles.nri_angle: Daler Mehndi's bhangra-pop defined diaspora party music for a generation; the row and its aftermath played out in public across Indian media.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jailer 2 Hindi Version Falls Short Of Hit Verdict Despite Strong Run
articles.excerpt: Koimoi says the Hindi-dubbed Jailer 2 has reached Rs 50.3 crore net in 24 days, Rs 1.7 crore short of the Rs 52 crore it says the version needed for a Hit verdict.
articles.image_caption: Rajinikanth is shown in his Jailer look, with grey-streaked hair, glasses and a beard. Koimoi reports the Hindi version of Jailer 2 has earned Rs 50.3 crore net in India in 24 days.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora audiences watching Jailer 2 overseas can see how its Hindi-dubbed version performed in India compared with its much larger all-language run.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dhanush Says No One but Sai Pallavi Could Have Played Sita in Ramayana
articles.excerpt: At the OM pre-release event on November 7, Dhanush dismissed the noise around Sai Pallavi's casting as Sita, pointing to her devotion and calling her a great performer.
articles.image_caption: Sai Pallavi at a Ramayana promotional event. Dhanush said no one other than Sai Pallavi could have played Sita in the film.
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana: Part 1 is in theatres now for diaspora audiences this Diwali season, and Dhanush's defence is the latest peer endorsement in the debate over its Sita.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cult: Vishwak Sen's Slasher Thriller Divides Critics with Its Gory Ambitions
articles.excerpt: While some appreciate its audacious approach, many find it lacking in substance.
articles.image_caption: Still from the official trailer of 'Cult'.
articles.nri_angle: With English subtitles available, Cult offers an intriguing glimpse into a genre rarely explored in Indian cinema, appealing to horror enthusiasts in the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.rating_consensus: Critics broadly appreciate Vishwak Sen's ambition and performance but criticize the film for its excessive violence and lack of narrative depth, resulting in a 2.5-star consensus across reviews.

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Ends Overseas Run at Rs 144.89 Crore, Ninth-Biggest Bollywood Grosser Abroad Post-COVID
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's crime thriller closed its international run as his biggest overseas grosser ever, with North America contributing an estimated $6.72 million, according to Koimoi's tracking.
articles.image_caption: A still from Drishyam 3, starring Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar. The film has ended its overseas run with an estimated Rs 144.89 crore gross, according to Koimoi.
articles.nri_angle: North America was the film's biggest overseas market — the diaspora audience made a Hindi thriller into a top-10 post-COVID international grosser.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.name: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani

articles.title: Simbu's 'Arasan' Promo Slips From Diwali to a Reported December 4 Theatre Release
articles.excerpt: The eight-minute 'World of Arasan' promo is finished except for Anirudh Ravichander's new background score, reports say, and the plan now is to attach it to Vijay Sethupathi's 'Train' in early December — reaching some 1,000 Tamil Nadu theatres instead of 100.
articles.image_caption: Director Vetrimaaran (left) with Silambarasan TR during the making of the Tamil film 'Arasan'. The film's eight-minute promo is now expected in theatres in December, reports say.
articles.nri_angle: The Arasan promo is planned for simultaneous theatrical and social-media release, so Tamil film fans in the US and elsewhere can expect to see it online the same day it reaches Tamil Nadu screens.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Pyre': An 18-Award Himalayan Love Story Arrives in Cinemas With First-Time Actors
articles.excerpt: Vinod Kapri's Hindi drama casts two Uttarakhand villagers, aged 80 and 70, as a couple waiting 28 years for their son — and it has already collected 18 international awards, 15 of them for Best Film.
articles.image_caption: The poster for Pyre, written, directed and produced by Vinod Kapri, introducing Padam Singh and Heera Devi. The Hindi drama opened in Indian cinemas on October 30 after winning 18 international awards.
articles.nri_angle: A film about parents left behind in a Himalayan village waiting for a migrant son speaks directly to diaspora families; it is in Indian cinemas now, with no US release announced yet.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.excerpt: Official trailer for Don't Trouble The Trouble – Fahadh Faasil — premieres Oct 30, 2026.
articles.image_caption: Still from the official trailer of Don't Trouble The Trouble – Fahadh Faasil.
articles.nri_angle: US theatrical release tracking for diaspora audiences.

articles.title: Karan Johar Says He Is Dissuading Twins Yash And Roohi From Bollywood
articles.excerpt: On Koffee With Karan, the filmmaker said the industry is tough and he will be too old to protect his children when they are ready — a view Kareena Kapoor gently pushed back on.
articles.image_caption: Karan Johar poses against a red curtain backdrop. The filmmaker says he is dissuading his twins, Yash and Roohi, from joining Bollywood.
articles.nri_angle: A prominent diaspora-followed filmmaker questioning a Bollywood career for his own children speaks to wider debates about nepotism, scrutiny and parenting in the public eye.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Ends BookMyShow Run As Bollywood's Tenth Highest Ticket-Seller Ever
articles.excerpt: The Hindi crime thriller starring Ajay Devgn sold 6.72 million tickets on BookMyShow in five weeks and closed with 379.65 crore net in India, becoming Devgn's highest ticket-selling film on the platform.
articles.image_caption: Drishyam
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora fans followed the concluding Hindi chapter overseas; the BookMyShow top-ten finish measures India platform ticket demand for a thriller-led franchise finale.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Salman Khan Calls Maatrubhumi Rewrite Claims 'Nonsense' at Trailer Launch
articles.excerpt: The Hindi war drama, earlier titled Battle of Galwan, is 'a film on soldiers and their families on both sides,' the actor said — not an anti-China film, and not rewritten under government pressure.
articles.image_caption: Salman Khan at the Maatrubhumi trailer launch in Mumbai. He dismissed claims that the government pressured the makers to rewrite the film's script.
articles.nri_angle: Maatrubhumi is scheduled to release in cinemas on December 4 — diaspora audiences will find it in the usual North America Bollywood theatrical circuit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Film Title: Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace

articles.title: Juhi Chawla Closes Apple's Diwali Film 'Step Into the Light,' Shot on iPhone 18 Pro
articles.excerpt: The Hindi-language festive film, made with Raw Mango and set at Rajasthan's Tijara Fort, revives her 1994 song 'Roop Suhana Lagta Hai' in a folk arrangement.
articles.image_caption: Dancers hold trays of diyas in Apple's Step Into the Light, with Juhi Chawla appearing at the close of the film. The Diwali campaign was shot entirely on iPhone 18 Pro at Tijara Fort in Rajasthan.
articles.nri_angle: Apple's Diwali film is streaming on Apple India's YouTube and Apple's global Instagram — a two-minute watch built around Indian textiles and a 1990s Bollywood song.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Diljit Dosanjh to Perform at Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas on November 12
articles.excerpt: The Latin Recording Academy added the Punjabi singer to the 27th annual ceremony at the MGM Grand Garden Arena, alongside Karol G and Bizarrap — watchable in the US on Univision and ViX.
articles.image_caption: Diljit Dosanjh sits at a piano. The Punjabi singer and actor will perform at the 27th Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas on November 12, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: For US-based fans, the November 12 ceremony airs live on Univision, UNIMÁS and Galavisión and streams on ViX from 8 p.m. ET/PT — no India-only broadcast needed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Regina Cassandra Says Dharma Dropped Her From Kesari Chapter 2 Promotions
articles.excerpt: The actor, who played Akshay Kumar's wife in the Hindi courtroom drama, says her name was dropped without explanation and a song featuring her was released without tagging her.
articles.nri_angle: A South Indian actor's experience in a Hindi production speaks to representation questions familiar to diaspora audiences who watch both industries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Aishwarya and Abhishek Arrive Hand-in-Hand at Manish Malhotra's Diwali Bash
articles.excerpt: The couple's rare joint appearance in a red saree and black sherwani led a smaller, intimate edition of the designer's annual Mumbai Diwali party on November 5.
articles.image_caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan (file photo). She arrived hand-in-hand with Abhishek Bachchan at Manish Malhotra's Diwali bash in Mumbai on November 5, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Malhotra's annual Diwali party is the Hindi film industry's most photographed festive night, and its looks set the Diwali dressing template diaspora boutiques copy within days.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Advance Sales Pass Nayanthara's Previous Opener
articles.excerpt: The Tamil fantasy sequel, releasing November 6 for Diwali, has Rs 1.26 crore in India advance sales, according to Koimoi — already above Hi's Rs 1.25 crore opening day, with a day of pre-sales left.
articles.image_caption: Nayanthara in her Mookuthi Amman 2 look, wearing a navy saree and nose ring in temple settings. The Tamil fantasy sequel releases in theatres worldwide on November 6, 2026, for Diwali.
articles.nri_angle: Tamil Diwali releases are a theatre ritual for the diaspora; the film opens worldwide November 6, with US showtimes to be checked locally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ramayana Opens With Rs 42.96 Crore in Day 1 Advance Sales, Bollywood's Second-Best Ever
articles.excerpt: 12.14 lakh tickets sold before the first show, a record 26,615 shows, and the highest pre-sales ever for a non-sequel — the Ranbir Kapoor-Yash epic starts its run in the record books.
articles.image_caption: Ramayana
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana released worldwide the same day; North American pre-sales ran 106% higher than Adipurush per Koimoi's companion tracking, making this a diaspora opening weekend too.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anuv Jain Says Independent Music Lets Him Wait for Right Bollywood Project
articles.excerpt: The Ludhiana singer-songwriter told IANS he has had Bollywood offers but is 'quite selective,' crediting his independent releases for the financial and audience foundation that lets him choose his first film project carefully.
articles.nri_angle: Jain's sold-out London Roundhouse show and more than 20 million monthly Spotify listeners show that diaspora and streaming audiences can now sustain an Indian independent career without a Bollywood launch.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Number One Hits on Asian Music Charts

articles.title: Ramayana Part 2 Will Arrive in 2028, Producer Namit Malhotra Confirms
articles.excerpt: On the eve of Part 1 release on November 5, producer Namit Malhotra has confirmed the sequel moves from its planned Diwali 2027 window to 2028, saying the finale needs the extra year. The Hindi film is also being made in a separate English master version.
articles.image_caption: Producer Namit Malhotra and artwork from Ramayana, with Yash as Ravana above Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman and Sai Pallavi as Sita. Malhotra has confirmed Part 2 will release in 2028 instead of 2027.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences, the English master version matters: Part 1 opens November 5 in two versions with different edits and runtimes, and Part 2 now lands in 2028.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
